items.a: Daycare is for ages 2 to 9. Tuition classes are grouped by age, shown on each class.
Choose a class, send the form, and we confirm within one working day. Spots are held once confirmed.

items.q: Can we try a class first?
items.a: Yes. Ask for a trial session in the message box and we will arrange one when a spot is open.

items.q: What if a class is full?
items.a: Join the waitlist from the class and we will contact you as soon as a place opens.

items.q: What is included in daycare fees?
items.a: Supervised care, learning activities, snacks and lunch. Please tell us about any allergies when you enrol.
